returns.title: Return & Exchange Policy
returns.intro: Your satisfaction matters to us. Please read how returns and exchanges work.
returns.body:
## Returns
If your item arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, contact us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery with your order number and clear photos.

## Exchange
We will gladly exchange an unused item for another size or hand option, subject to availability.

## Not returnable
- Customized or made-to-order bats
- Items that have been used or played with

## How to start
Message us on WhatsApp with your order number. We will confirm the next steps within 1 to 2 working days.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: How and when your SA Sports order reaches you.
shipping.body:
## Delivery in Pakistan
Orders are dispatched from Sialkot within 1 to 3 working days. Delivery usually takes 3 to 5 working days.

## International orders
We ship worldwide. Shipping cost and time are confirmed on WhatsApp before you pay.

## Tracking
Once your parcel is dispatched we send you the courier name and tracking number.

## Payment
Cash on delivery is available in Pakistan. Bank and wallet transfers are also accepted.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How SA Sports handles your information.
privacy.body:
## What we collect
Only what you give us when you order: name, phone number, city and delivery address.

## How we use it
We use it only to confirm, pack and deliver your order and to answer your questions. We do not sell your information.

## Cards
This website never takes card details.

## Contact
For any privacy question message us on WhatsApp.
